**n12 — borrowed app and runtime references**
```text
src/Surface.zig                     D 74-79
src/Surface.zig                     DI 474-484
src/Surface.zig                     I 624-626
src/Surface.zig                     U 870-876,881-893
src/apprt/embedded.zig              D 451-451
src/apprt/embedded.zig              UI 615-624,634-646
src/apprt/gtk/class/surface.zig     D 666-666
src/apprt/gtk/class/surface.zig     UI 3561-3570,3610-3629,1963-1978
```
The host owns the core: embedded passes itself and its app to its inline core; GTK allocates the core, supplies the app and runtime wrapper pointers, and destroys the core in finalization. Core shutdown releases its own resources, not those host pointers.

The renderer message carries **two** derived configs (thread and renderer implementation). `setFontSize` also publishes the new shared grid before `change_config`. The I/O message carries a separately allocated Termio derived config; the receiving thread destroys the pointer after Termio adopts its contents.

**n18 — key, mouse and paste encoding**
```text
src/Surface.zig                     D 2792-2795,3918-3923
src/Surface.zig                     UI 2834-2846,2938-2961,3067-3082,3304-3315,4057-4094

```
Terminal key modes and the active screen’s Kitty flags are read in `key_encode.Options.fromTerminal`; mouse event mode/format are read independently in `mouse_encode.Options.fromTerminal`. Raw `textCallback` uses the ordinary paste encoder, **not** the keyboard encoder. Actual clipboard paste requests additionally support mode 5522 MIME-list events.

**n19 — queueIo, transfer of ownership and readonly guard**
```text
src/Surface.zig                     D 171-175
src/Surface.zig                     DI 895-920
src/Surface.zig                     U 2953-2957,3871-3874,6335-6340
src/Surface.zig                     I 5555-5563
src/termio/message.zig              D 91-98
src/termio/message.zig              I 118-132
src/termio/Termio.zig               DI 437-447
src/termio/mailbox.zig              I 47-55,57-98,100-108
src/termio/Thread.zig               UI 289-302,308-313,349-366
```
Only `.write_small`, `.write_stable`, and `.write_alloc` are discarded by `queueIo` in readonly mode. Passing a non-write message still transfers it to `Termio.queueMessage`; dropped owned payloads are deinitialized. This guard concerns writes **from the surface**, not protocol replies generated independently by Termio.

**n16 — complete input callbacks and runtime entry paths**

```text
+n17 +n18 +n19
```
GTK IM commits can reach `keyCallback` as UTF-8 with an unidentified key. The embedded text API actually calls `textCallback`. The full mouse callback includes the local selection, link, prompt, clipboard and context-menu paths in addition to reporting mouse bytes.

For the combined candidate, also union the Surface-owned responsibilities from **d1.n22–n48** into n11 (especially renderer-state aliasing, worker startup and shutdown, child exit and runtime close). The ownership-establishing connection specific to n11 is `Surface.init` constructing **one** Exec backend, adopting it into `self.io`, pointing renderer state to `&self.io.terminal`, and starting the two sibling threads at `src/Surface.zig:623-649,687-725,753-767`.
